_about: Approved answers for the fictional Northwind Energia customer-service agent, in Italian and English. The agent may only answer from these texts. Every answer was signed off by the client's content owner (fictional). Policy details are invented.

examples_it: perche la bolletta e cosi alta
examples_en: why is my bill so high
explain the charges on my invoice
bill_explanation.answer_it: La bolletta ha tre voci principali: energia consumata, trasporto e gestione del contatore, oneri e imposte. Se l'importo e piu alto del solito, spesso dipende da una lettura stimata o da un conguaglio. Nell'area clienti trova il dettaglio dei consumi mese per mese.
bill_explanation.answer_en: Your bill has three main parts: energy used, transport and meter management, and system charges and taxes. If it is higher than usual, the usual causes are an estimated reading or a balancing adjustment. Your online account shows consumption month by month.

examples_it: come comunico la lettura del contatore
examples_en: how do i submit a meter reading
meter_reading.answer_it: Puo comunicare l'autolettura dall'area clienti o dall'app, tra il 25 e l'ultimo giorno del mese. Basta inserire i numeri neri del contatore, senza decimali.
meter_reading.answer_en: You can submit a meter reading in your online account or the app, from the 25th to the last day of the month. Enter the black digits on the meter, without decimals.

examples_it: trasloco attivare la fornitura nella nuova casa
examples_en: set up supply at my new home
moving_house.answer_it: Per un trasloco serve chiudere la fornitura nella vecchia casa e attivarla nella nuova. Puo fare entrambe le richieste dall'area clienti, alla voce Trasloco, almeno 10 giorni lavorativi prima della data.
moving_house.answer_en: When you move, the supply at the old address is closed and a new one opened at the new address. You can request both in your online account under Moving home, at least 10 working days before the date.

payment_methods.answer_it: Puo pagare con domiciliazione bancaria, carta dall'area clienti o bollettino. La domiciliazione si attiva dall'area clienti e vale dalla bolletta successiva.
payment_methods.answer_en: You can pay by direct debit, by card in your online account, or by payment slip. Direct debit is set up in your online account and applies from the next bill.

examples_en: electricity is off in my street
outage.answer_it: I guasti sulla rete sono gestiti dal distributore locale, che risponde 24 ore su 24 al numero verde indicato in bolletta alla voce Pronto intervento. Se nessun vicino ha corrente, si tratta probabilmente di un guasto di rete.
outage.answer_en: Faults on the network are handled by the local distributor, available 24/7 on the emergency number printed on your bill. If your neighbours have no power either, it is probably a network fault.

examples_en: i want to make a complaint
complaint.reason: formal complaints and legal threats go to a person

payment_hardship.reason: payment plans need an assessment by a trained advisor

vulnerability.reason: possible vulnerable customer: priority handling by a person

account_change.reason: changes to bank details or account holder need identity checks

escalation_keywords._about: Safety net: any of these words or phrases sends the conversation to a person, whatever else matches. Kept deliberately broad; an unnecessary handoff costs minutes, a missed one can harm a customer.
